subject: maths
question: A can complete 2/5th part of the work in 12 days and B can complete 7/8th part of the same work in 21 days. Find the number of days in which A and B together can complete the work.
solution:
Given:

A can complete 2/5 work in 12 days

B can complete 7/8 work in 21 days

**Concept:**

Work efficiency is inversely proportional to time taken.

Calculation:

⇒ A's full work will take (12 / 2) × 5 = 30 days.

⇒ B's full work will take (21 / 7) × 8 = 24 days.

Total work = LCM(30, 24) = 120

Efficiency of A = 120/30 = 4

Efficiency of B = 120/24 = 5

Efficiency of A and B = 4 + 5 = 9

Days taken by A and B together to complete the work = 120/9 = 40/3 days

**Therefore, the number of days in which A and B together can complete the work is 40/3 days.**
